content: Baseline designs evaluated: id 1 (reward -1.029, gain 611.8, phm 31.1, ugbw 24.1M, SR 23.1, current 175.1uA) and id 2 (reward -1.218, gain 102.4 with ln1=45nm). Handing over to diagnoser with id 1 as base. Primary levers needed: increase gm6 (I2 and mp3) to push p2, reduce Cc or boost Itail for SR and UGBW, keeping ln1>=90nm for gain.

Best candidate: id 1 (reward -1.029, infeasible). Binding constraints: ugbw (-0.612, 24.1MHz), phm (-0.317, 31.1 deg), slewRate (-0.130, 23.1 V/us). Gain (+0.507) and noise (+0.152) have ample margin. Chosen lever: reduce Cc (currently 1.5pF) towards 0.6-0.8pF to boost UGBW and slewRate, accompanied by Rc increase to introduce LHP zero phase lead for PM.

Sweep on Cc (id 3-7): Cc=0.4pF (id 3) reached reward -0.8195, UGBW=48.3MHz, SR=40.6V/us. PM dropped to 19.2 deg because 2nd pole p2=gm6/CL (CL=10pF) is at ~24MHz. Next: boost gm6 via mn5 and mp3 while maintaining balance condition to push p2 and PM up.

Rc sweep (id 14-19): Rc=8500 ohm (id 19) achieved PM=65.89 deg, UGBW=77.4MHz, SR=48.1V/us, Gain=611.8, reward=-0.1079. Only UGBW remains violated (77.4MHz vs 100MHz). Ready for Diagnoser to address final UGBW margin.

Best candidate: id 19 (reward -0.1079, only ugbw violated at 77.4MHz; phm 65.9 deg, SR 48.1, gain 611.8). Binding spec: ugbw (-0.127). Chosen lever: increase input pair width via mn1 (6 -> 9) to raise gm1 without increasing bias current, and test Cc=0.3pF to clear the 100MHz threshold into feasibility.

Phase 1 complete at 25 sims. Best candidate: id 25 (reward -0.0406; only ugbw=-0.0583 left to clear, PM 60.3 deg, gain 617.5, SR 51.7). Handing over to RL strategist anchored on id 25 to discover feasible solutions in the local neighborhood.

Phase 3 complete: 800 sims used. 15 feasible designs found. Best FoM improved from -0.0406 (id 25) to 0.6358 (id 518, fully feasible: gain 987.6, ugbw 117.3M, phm 60.6 deg, SR 59.85, current 219.3uA, area 8.95e-10). RL increased ln1 to 135nm (boosting DC gain to 987.6) and balanced mp3=12 with mn5=13. Handing over to diagnoser for Phase 4 polish.

Phase 4 Polish on id 518 (FoM=0.6358). Specs: Gain=987.6, SR=59.9, UGBW=117.3M, PM=60.6 deg (tightest). Area=8.95e-10, Current=219.3uA. Chosen lever: sweep cap [0.3p..0.6p] to minimize area while verifying PM >= 60 deg.
Mandatory loop back to RL round 2: 828/1000 simulator calls used. Anchoring RL on new best feasible design id 518 (FoM=0.6358). Sizing round 2 batch to exhaust remaining budget up to >=900 calls.

RL Round 2 complete: total simulator calls reached 938/1000 (>=900 limit). Best feasible candidate: id 843 (FoM=0.6637; gain 882.6, ugbw 110.9MHz, phm 62.1 deg, SR 59.74, current 207.7uA, area 8.93e-10). Total feasible designs: 23. Handing over to Reviewer.

Review complete. Best candidate: id 843 (FoM=0.6637, feasible=True). Specs: Gain 882.6, UGBW 110.9MHz, PM 62.10 deg, SR 59.74 V/us, Noise 18.99mV RMS, Current 207.7uA, Area 8.931e-10 m^2. Detailed explanation written to harness_runs/harness_20261106_202431/explanation.md.
